description:
By all appearances, Ragou is your ordinary black coated feline. He`s also the legendary mononoke once feared as the Black Star of Doom. Owing to his lengthy imprisonment as a sealed-away spirit, Ragou is a shadow of his former self with only a faint grasp of the past. Ragou may be unquestionably cold and independent, yet it`s his warmth and rare intellect that manage to shine through. When in their thirst for power the mononoke launch a strike against Ragou, he is left for dead, until, that is, Jirou comes to the rescue. The surprising gesture not only earns Ragou`s trust but sparks an unlikely alliance.
Source: Official page
name: Ragou
